info.title: pdfnetstack-ocr: make scanned PDF files searchable from the command line
info.description: Command line OCR for PDF files: finds the scan on each page, recognizes Latin and Arabic text with the PP-OCRv5 models on ONNX Runtime, turns pages scanned sideways or upside down, and adds an invisible text layer so the PDF can be searched and copied. Models and runtime included; also runs as `pdfnetstack ocr` next to PdfNetStack.Tool. Install with: dotnet tool install -g PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool. MIT licensed. By Jamal Abdelkhalek, JADEV.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: pdfnetstack-ocr: make scanned PDF files searchable

options.name: --languages
options.description:
Scripts to read, comma separated: latin, arabic (Arabic also
reads Persian and Urdu). Default: latin

options.name: --models
options.description:
Load the models from this folder instead of the ones
installed with the tool

options.name: --min-confidence
options.description: Leave out lines read with less confidence (default 0.5)

options.name: --no-orientation
options.description: Do not look for pages scanned sideways or upside down

options.name: --all-pages
options.description: Also read pages that already show text

options.name: --threads
options.description: Pages recognized at once (default: all cores)

options.name: --text
options.description: Also write the text found, pages apart by a blank line

options.name: --json
options.description:
Machine readable report
Exit codes: 0 done, 1 written but some pages failed, 2 nothing written.
